proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: removing agitation during the 16 h reaction period could reduce solid potassium carbonate contact with the organic-phase reactants and slow methylation.
Hypothesis: replacing the potassium carbonate addition with an additional methyl iodide charge removes the stated base function, potentially limiting enolate formation.
Hypothesis: deleting the provisional reactor-to-heater connection removes the defined temperature-control path for the 25 °C reaction hold.
Hypothesis: deleting the heater-stirrer device makes the specified controlled, stirred 25 °C hold operationally unavailable.
